stem.text: Which tissue in the respiratory system is correctly linked to its function?

A.text: cartilage; stretch and recoil to force air out

B.text: ciliated epithelium; gives protection from suspended particles in the air

C.text: elastic fibres; contract and relax to adjust diameter of bronchioles

D.text: smooth muscle; keeps trachea and bronchi open
